newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA ANNOUNCE SQUAD FOR SLOVAKIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAVIA ANNOUNCE SQUAD FOR SLOVAKIA.

text.p: Yugoslav national soccer coach Slobodan Santrac announced a 22-player squad on Monday for the country's group six World Cup qualifier against Slovakia in Belgrade on June 8.
Yugoslavia are currently second in group six with 16 points from seven matches behind Spain who have 17 from seven. Slovakia are third with 12 points from from five games.
Squad - Goalkeepers: Ivica Kralj (Partizan Belgrade), Dragoje Lekovic (Kilmarnock, Scotland), Aleksandar Kocic (ex-Perugia, Italy).

Defenders: Zoran Mirkovic (Atalanta, Italy), Goran Djorovic (Red Star Belgrade), Miroslav Djukic (Deportivo Coruna, Spain), Sinisa Mihajlovic (Sampdoria, Italy), Albert Nadj (Betis, Spain), Nisa Saveljic (Partizan Belgrade).

Midfielders: Dragan Stojkovic (Nagoya Grampus Eight, Japan), Dejan Savicevic (AC Milan, Italy), Slavisa Jokanovic (Tenerife, Spain), Dejan Govedarica (Volendam, Netherlands), Vladimir Jugovic (Juventus, Italy), Branko Brnovic (Espanol, Spain), Zeljko Petrovic (PSV Eindhoven, Netherlands), Ljubinko Drulovic (Porto, Portugal), Dragan Ciric (Partizan Belgrade).
Strikers: Predrag Mijatovic (Real Madrid, Spain), Savo Milosevic (Aston Villa, England), Anto Drobnjak (Bastia, France), Darko Kovacevic (Real Sociedad, Spain).
